items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: "the original song with Bobby Keys I’m not playing like Bobby but I don’t want to be too far from it"

ctx.x: Yeah. Is that harder or easier, or is it both? I mean if you were playing “Groovin’ High” and then you play, over here you’ve got a two chord vamp, which is more challenging?

You know they both have their challenges, not challenges but I don’t want to say limitations, they both have their differences in the sense that with “Groovin’ High” I’m just playing with a jazz group and I can kind of — do I defer to Dizzy and Bird, thinking about that, or do I just try to do my thing on that song? But I’m still trying to do my thing also on “Miss You” because the original song with Bobby Keys I’m not playing like Bobby but I don’t want to be too far from it because I’m riffing, and again I’m…
But there’s more chord — there’s a chord progression to pay more attention to.
